backend/main.mo: Main canister defining user profiles, order types, authorization checks, and CRUD operations for orders using Map storage and mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new format by updating order owner type and passing through user profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend component, page, and hook used in the app.
frontend/.env.example: Template environment variable file showing required backend canister ID and Internet Identity URL for local development.
frontend/.env.production: Production environment variable template defining backend canister ID and II URL for deployments.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining prerequisites and high-level steps for deploying the app to the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration defining color variables, dark mode values, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document loading the React app entry point and containing the root mounting element.
frontend/src/@types/html2canvas.d.ts: Type declaration placeholder file for html2canvas integration.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application routing setup with auth-gated routes, admin routes, and session-based auth provider.
frontend/src/components/AdminGate.tsx: Component that restricts access to admin-only content using session-based admin checks and error messaging.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, disclaimer banner, content area, and footer across all pages.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Auth wrapper that blocks access until session auth loads and redirects unauthenticated users to sign‑in.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Button showing sign‑in or sign‑out state and handling navigation and logout cleanup.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Top navigation header with branding, dashboard/admin links, and auth status button.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Provides buttons to export the ID card as PNG or print it with error handling.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Renders a styled ID card preview showing photo, personal details, state seal, and watermarks.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Displays a large centered watermark indicating roleplay-only identification.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Modal for cropping photos to ID aspect ratio with drag, zoom, and canvas export.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Image uploader supporting drag‑and‑drop, validation, previews, and clearing the selected photo.
frontend/src/components/RoleplayDisclaim: Banner displaying a roleplay‑only and not‑real‑ID disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Shows a state seal image with fallback icon when the seal asset is unavailable.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Static list of U.S. states with two‑letter codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Centralized text constants for disclaimers and UI messaging.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: Hook that queries whether the current authenticated actor has admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useSessionAuth.t: Provides session auth context with localStorage-backed sign-in, sign-up, and sign-out functions.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query keys for orders and auth state.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Fetches all orders via actor when available.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Creates an order and stores its ID per user, then invalidates user order queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Fetches a single order by ID using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useUpdateOrder: Updates an order's status and invalidates related queries.
Loads user-specific orders using stored IDs in localStorage and actor lookups.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading and managing identities via AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom theme variables, utilities, and print styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin page listing all orders with status update controls.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the user's orders, loading states, and navigation for creating or viewing individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page showing the app's hero section and a step-by-step overview of how the service works.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new ID order, handling validation, photo upload/cropping, and submission.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific order, including status, ID preview, and error/loading states.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Provides a login form with validation, error handling, and navigation after successful sign‑in.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Offers a registration form with password validation, success feedback, and redirect to sign‑in.
frontend/src/utils/exportIdCard.ts: Exports an ID card DOM element to a PNG via canvas/SVG and provides a print fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Formats an order status string by capitalizing its first letter.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Finds a US state by name and returns the file path to its seal image.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing app purpose, architecture notes, features, and current state.
